tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po'i las rim gsal sgron gyi mchod pa kha 'gengs yig rnying ltar bzhugs so//

hūm̐ rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas pa la// dur khrod rdzas kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ rba rlabs 'khrugs// myos byed chang gi zhabs bsil mtsho ltar bskyil// dug chang gdug pa'i 'thor 'thung lbu phreng g.yo// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bsgral ba'i snying mig rna ba sna dang lce// dri dang dug gi me tog sngon po sogs// drag po'i rdzas kyi me tog ji snyed pa| |rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// lha min khrag dang yungs kar rnga bong sbangs// dug dang sha chen 'dre 'jigs sbyar ba'i spos| |mkha' dbyings sprin tshogs bdug spos dam pa 'di// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// phyugs chen nya phag bya rog rkang dang tshil// dmar nag chen po'i snang gsal nyi ma ltar// rab 'bar mi zad 'od phreng 'khrugs pa 'di// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bdud rtsi lnga dang mkhris chen bong bu'i chu// mi khrag dug dang sbyar ba'i dri yi chab// bku zhing ngad ldan rab tu gtams pa yang*// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// nas nag til nag bra sran ram phye yi// bshos bu zur gsum sha khrag rus pa bcas| |bza' bca' sna tshogs spod kyis bran pa'i tshogs// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thod rnga rkang gling cha lang rnga bo che// dung dang bshug glu dbyangs kyi nga ro'i sgra// 'brug stong grags ltar sa yang rab 'dar ba// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi ra sa yān// 'ben chen rgyu rkyen gsang ba'i ru dhī ra// sna tshogs bcud ldan dam rdzas gtor mar bcas// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// gzhan yang sbyor sgrol de bzhin nyid la sogs// mtha' yas mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams khyab pa// dngos 'byor yid sprul ma tshang med pa'i tshogs// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// sgrub mchog bdag gi re 'bras 'grub par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ka wu wa sa pa ri wā rā ya sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hā/

zhes pa 'di'ang rang lugs kyi mgon po'i las rim gsal sgron gyi 'o ma chu gtsang ma'i rjes su sbyar na chos skyong gi mchod par 'brel chags shing*/ lhag par be'u bum 'bum gsum ma sogs mgon po'i sgrub skor rnying pa rnams su dur khrod rdzas kyi mchod pa nyid gsungs pa dang bstun/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
